strokes.text: Manages a whole group as one resource: the group, its placement in the scene, and an ordered list of image children with their placements.
Because the group is one resource, the provider repairs it as a unit: a child deleted in OBS is recreated in place without disturbing its siblings.
Use it when a group must always be complete, and never manage the same group with @resources/group as well.
Group resources need the native bridge plugin loaded in OBS; see @guides/groups.
Every child is an `image_source` with an absolute `file`.
Each child has a `stable_key`, the identity Terraform tracks it by, which must match `[a-z0-9_-]+` and be unique in the group.
The `index` in each child placement must equal the position of the child in the `children` list.
Renaming the group, changing the key, name or kind of an existing child, and removing a child are rejected at plan time.
Import by collection name, scene UUID, group UUID and group scene item ID, followed by one binding for each child:

glazes.children: Ordered list of the sources inside the group, bottom layer first. At least one child is required.
glazes.children.item_id: Scene item ID that OBS assigned to the child inside the group.
glazes.children.name: Name of the child source as shown in OBS. It must be unique in the group and cannot change once the child exists.
glazes.children.placement: Visibility, lock state, order and transform of the child inside the group. Positions are measured from the top-left corner of the group.
glazes.children.present: Must be `true`: every declared child exists.
glazes.children.source_uuid: UUID that OBS assigned to the child source.
glazes.children.stable_key: Identity of the child in Terraform, matching `[a-z0-9_-]+`. It cannot change once the child exists.
glazes.group_uuid: UUID that OBS assigned to the group.
glazes.name: Name of the group as shown in OBS. A rename is rejected at plan time.
glazes.observed_children: The children as OBS reported them at the last read, including any that are missing.
glazes.observed_children.height: Height in pixels that OBS reported for the child source.
glazes.observed_children.item_id: Scene item ID of the child that OBS reported.
glazes.observed_children.kind: Kind of the child source that OBS reported.
glazes.observed_children.name: Name of the child source that OBS reported.
glazes.observed_children.present: Whether the child existed in the group at the last read.
glazes.observed_children.source_uuid: UUID of the child source that OBS reported.
glazes.observed_children.stable_key: Key of the declared child this observation belongs to.
glazes.observed_children.width: Width in pixels that OBS reported for the child source.
glazes.observed_complete: Whether the last read found the group, its placement and every declared child.
glazes.observed_parent: The group placement as OBS reported it at the last read.
glazes.observed_parent.present: Whether the group was placed in its scene at the last read.
glazes.parent_item_id: Scene item ID of the group in its scene. Reference it from `item_ids` of @resources/scene_contents.
glazes.parent_placement: Visibility, lock state, order and transform of the group in its scene.
glazes.parent_placement.enabled: Whether the group is visible in its scene.
glazes.parent_placement.index: Zero-based position of the group in its scene, counted from the bottom layer up.
glazes.parent_placement.locked: Whether the group is locked against editing in the OBS interface.
glazes.parent_present: Must be `true`: the group is always placed in its scene.
glazes.repair_nonce: Marker that becomes unknown in a plan when the group needs repair, so that the repair shows up as a change.
